capabilities: Embed countdown timers in notes via code blocks with title, date, and time parameters
Configure date format, title visibility, and unit labels in settings
Count up or display Complete! after a countdown expires
Place timers on consecutive lines to display them side by side
extras: README states the plugin was built with Claude Opus 4.5; timers work in Reading view only.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to show live countdown timers, forcing users to resort to clunky iframes.
summary: Code-block plugin that embeds countdown timers in notes for tracking vacations, deadlines, and due dates.
